sentences: I am a huge movie buff and most of my spare time goes into watching movies.
My favorite genre is action and nobody does it better than the greatest action hero of all time Tom Cruise.
I simply idolize him and had always dreamt of meeting him in person someday.
Last year one of the India’s leading news channel organized a youth icon event and one of the speakers in that event was Tom Cruise.
I could not believe it as I might finally could get to see him in flesh and blood.
But there was one problem the entry to the event was by invite only.
Luckily one of my friends’ father works in a news channel and when I shared my desire with him he promised to help me.
He delivered on his promise and his father got me the invite to the event.
I reached there an hour early as I was beaming with excitement to meet my idol.
The event started with a welcome ceremony and a short talk from the host of the event.

Then the question and answer session started and couple of luminaries from different fields shared their experiences but I could not focus on a word as with bated breath I was waiting for the moment for which I had went there.
Finally he was there on the stage and unsurprisingly he got the loudest applause of the day.
I had never seen such a handsome man before, complete in every sense of the word.
In black tuxedo he was looking like a Greek god.
The way he walked on the stage and greeted the audience was the epitome of confidence.
I can never forget that face glowing with assurance and nobility.
The way he carried himself on the stage was simply textbook work.
He was easily the most handsome man on the stage and everybody else just faded in his comparison.
Everything was just perfect about him, the way he sat, the way he gestured, the way he answered the questions and addressed the audience.
He is one of the biggest movie stars ever but not once it reflected in his attitude or the way he spoke.
He was behaving like a quintessential humble celebrity who still has his feet on the ground and personified humility.
I wish most of the celebrities behave like him and set a perfect example for their admirers.
